title: CaptureZone
description: Territory capture mod for Forge 1.20.1. Create zones, fight for control, earn rewards. Animated borders, cooldowns, fully configurable messages and HUD.
body:
# CaptureZone

**CaptureZone** is a Minecraft Forge mod that adds a fully configurable territory capture system to your server. Create custom zones, set up rewards, and let players fight for control!

---

## ⚑ Features

- **Create capture zones** of any size anywhere in the world
- **Animated zone borders** — red (available), green (capturing), blue (on cooldown)
- **Progress bar HUD** with custom PNG textures
- **Item & command rewards** for capturing a zone
- **Cooldown system** — zones become unavailable for a configurable time after capture
- **Minimum player requirement** — zones stay locked until enough players are online
- **Rollback system** — progress resets if the capturer dies or leaves the zone
- **Fully configurable messages** with color codes and placeholders
- **No restart needed** — reload config with `/womzone reload`

---

## 🛠 Commands

| Command | Description |
|---|---|
| `/womzone pos1` | Set first corner of the zone |
| `/womzone pos2` | Set second corner of the zone |
| `/womzone create <name>` | Create a zone from selected corners |
| `/womzone delete <name>` | Delete a zone |
| `/womzone reload` | Reload all configs without restart |
| `/womzone delay` | Show active cooldowns |
| `/womzone checkzone` | List all zones |
| `/womzone checkzone <name>` | Show info about a specific zone |

**Permission level required:** 2 (operator)

---

## ⚙ Zone Configuration

Each zone is stored as a JSON file in `config/CaptureZone/zones/`:

```json
{
  "name": "base",
  "world": "minecraft:overworld",
  "nameworlds": "Raid",
  "namelocation": "Military Base",
  "captureSeconds": 120,
  "cooldownSeconds": 300,
  "playerresetSeconds": 30,
  "maxPlayers": 10,
  "rewardItems": [
    { "itemId": "minecraft:diamond", "amount": 1, "chance": 100.0 }
  ],
  "rewardCommand": {
    "enabled": true,
    "command": "give %player% minecraft:emerald 1"
  }
}
```

---

## 💬 Messages

All HUD messages are stored in `config/CaptureZone/messages.yml` with full support for:
- **Color codes** (`§a`, `§c`, `§e`, etc.)
- **Placeholders** (`%player%`, `%zone%`, `%location%`, `%secs%`, etc.)
- **Enable/disable** each message individually
- **Hot reload** via `/womzone reload`

---

## 📋 Requirements

- Minecraft **1.20.1**
- Forge **47.x**

---
